##### Project general facts

Kyomi Residences by ANAX Developments is a boutique mixed-use residential building that combines contemporary architecture, functional layouts and everyday convenience. The building rises from a ground floor and a single podium level to six residential floors. Bold horizontal lines, deep balconies, softly curved edges and panoramic glazing create a clean, layered silhouette. The collection offers studios and one- and two-bedroom apartments, complemented by retail units at ground level that bring daily services right to the doorstep.

Amenities are designed around wellbeing and a relaxed routine. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool surrounded by a pool deck and lounge areas, indoor and outdoor gyms and an outdoor yoga platform for morning practice. A tranquil Zen Garden, a jogging and walking track, an open-air amphitheatre for outdoor cinema evenings and a children's play area add variety for families, while showers, changing rooms, a welcoming lobby, lifts and round-the-clock security complete the shared spaces.

Interiors follow a modern style, with high ceilings and full-height glazing that fill each home with natural light. Open living areas connect directly with fully equipped kitchens featuring built-in appliances and practical storage, and selected one-bedroom homes include walk-in wardrobes for extra convenience. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste, while smart home features make daily living more efficient.

##### Location description and benefits

Warsan Fourth is a growing residential district in eastern Dubai, set between International City, Dubai Silicon Oasis and Dubai Academic City. The area combines modern apartment buildings with everyday retail, clinics and community services, and its calm, low-density streets appeal to students, young professionals and families looking for a practical, well-connected address away from the busier city centre districts.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Ras Al Khor Road connect residents with the wider city. The Life Medical Center sits close to home, while Dragon Mart, the University of Birmingham Dubai and City Centre Mirdif are a short drive away. Dubai Safari Park, Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and The Dubai Mall are within comfortable reach, and schools, universities and supermarkets serve the surrounding communities.

Warsan Fourth is a freehold area open to international buyers and one of the more accessible entry points to the Dubai property market. Proximity to Dubai Academic City and Dubai Silicon Oasis supports steady rental demand from students, academics and professionals. Compact studios and one-bedroom homes with resort-style amenities attract investors seeking healthy rental yields, while improving infrastructure in eastern Dubai underpins long-term value for owners.
